documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Manorama Industries reported strong consolidated financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by healthy demand, higher sales volumes, and a strong product mix. Revenue for Q2 FY27 reached INR459 crores, representing a 41.9% increase year-on-year, while EBITDA grew by 34.4% to INR118 crores with an EBITDA margin of 25.8%. For H1 FY27, revenue grew by 40.8% to INR863 crores and PAT increased by 59.2% to INR159 crores, with exports accounting for 61% of total H1 revenue. Management highlighted that the company's balance sheet is robust, with net debt-to-equity at 0.04x as of September 30, 2026, and announced leadership structure changes to support future execution and scale. Manorama Industries Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, with Q2 revenue growing 41.9% YoY to ₹4,589 million and PAT rising 51.8% to ₹808 million.

guidance.claim: The company expects capacity utilization to be around 80% to 85% for the full year FY27.
guidance.quote: So we expect our to be around 80%, 85% for full year for this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand remains very healthy and current capacities are quite booked for the next year.
demand_outlook.quote: The demands are very healthy. Currently, our capacities are also quite booked for the next kind of year.

demand_outlook.claim: Extended shelf life and better storage performance make CBE suitable for tropical markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Extended shelf life and better storage performance make CBE particularly suitable for tropical markets such as India, Southeast Asia and the Middle East.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer preference for plant-based and naturally sourced ingredients is driving demand for specialty cosmetic oils and butters.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer preference for plant-based and naturally sourced ingredients is driving demand for specialty cosmetic oils and butters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that demand across end-use industries remains sustained.
demand_outlook.quote: Our profitability grew by 67.6% year-on-year, reflecting sustained demand across the end use industries, deeper customer relationships and the increasing contribution of our value-added specialty fats and butters portfolio.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has invested approximately INR70 crores to INR75 crores towards current capital expenditure.
capex_expansion.quote: Including our working progress and the amount we already have capitalized, we have invested around INR70 crores-INR75 crores towards our current capex, and we expect to invest more in the coming quarters, in the second half of the year and in the next fiscal year as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Land has been acquired in Burkina Faso and regulatory approvals are being awaited.
capex_expansion.quote: We already have acquired the land in Burkina Faso, as we already have intimated in our last board meeting. We are expecting regulatory approvals towards the land, and we believe that we can update you much more in detail, maybe in the coming quarters as well, as the capex progresses.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to expand capacity by debottlenecking fractionation capacity.
Management plans to scale refining by adding refining capability in a forward-integration program.
capex_expansion.quote: Scale Refining Add refining capability (forward-integration program)

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning the development of a 15 MW captive solar power plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Planning the development of a 15 MW captive solar power plant as part of Manorama's renewable energy transition and decarbonization strategy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its sourcing footprint in West Africa through the incorporation of Manorama Savannah Agro Chad Sarl in Chad.
capex_expansion.quote: We expanded our sourcing footprint in West Africa through the incorporation of Manorama Savannah Agro Chad Sarl in Chad, our wholly owned subsidiary in Chad.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired approximately 10 hectares, equivalent to 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, we acquired approximately 10 hectares, 24 acres of land in Burkina Faso for a shea nut and mango nut processing facility with regulatory approvals currently in the progress.

capex_expansion.claim: Solvent fractionation plant 3 and the refinery are targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Burkina Faso project involves a capex of approximately INR 120 crores to INR 130 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So that Burkina Faso facility will be around INR120 crores, INR 130 odd crores approximately, and the balance should be for Indian projects out of INR 460 crores of our proposed capex plan.

capex_expansion.claim: Total planned capex investment for financial year 2027 is approximately INR 225 crores to INR 250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ballpark capex guidance for this year should be around INR 225 crores to INR 250-odd crores of investment in financial year approximately in FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 25.8% despite higher inbound freight costs and global macro shipping events.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin was 25.8% in quarter 2, despite higher inbound freight costs, global macro events, example, shipping routes, et cetera.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin was reported at 26%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew by 38% to INR224 crores, with EBITDA margin of 26%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for H1 FY27 expanded by 213 basis points to 18.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 59.2% to INR159 crores, and profit after tax margin expanded 213 basis points to 18.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin for Q2FY27 was 42.5%.
Profit after tax margin expanded by 326 basis points to 19.5% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 67.6% year-on-year, that is INR 79 crores with profit after tax margin expanding by 326 basis points to 19.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost run rate going forward is expected to be around INR 14 crores to INR 15 crores per quarter.
margins_costs.quote: But currently, the run rate, which we can take should be around INR 14 crores to INR 15 crores per quarter going forward. It should be generally in this line only.

orders_capacity.claim: Current plant utilization is approximately 85% on an expanded capacity of 47,500 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our plant utilization remains approximately around 85% on the expanded capacity, which we believe currently is operating 47,500 tons of capacity on 85% utilization roughly.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports accounted for 61% of H1FY27 revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: exports accounting for 61% of H1FY27 revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: The geographical domestic to export revenue mix for H1FY27 stood at 39:61.
orders_capacity.quote: The Domestic to Export Revenue Mix for H1FY27 stood at 39:61.

orders_capacity.claim: An additional 4,500 tons of capacity is expected to be added through debottlenecking, taking total capacity from 47,500 tons to approximately 52,000 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: So approximately, we are expecting additional 4,500 tons of debottlenecking in this financial year, additionally. So our current capacity of 47,500 tons will be going to around approximately to around 52,000 tons per annum.

capital_allocation.claim: Inventory stood at INR1,000 crores as of September 30, 2026, due to earlier shea procurement alongside seasonal sal and mango seed procurement.
capital_allocation.quote: Inventory was INR1,000 crores as of 30th September, 2026, compared with INR728 crores in March. The main reason is that our shea procurement started earlier this year, alongside our seasonal procurement of sal and mango seeds.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt-to-equity improved to 0.04x as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September, 2026, net debt-to-equity was 0.04x compared with 0.38x at the end of FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully completed a qualified institutional placement (QIP).
capital_allocation.quote: The successful completion of our qualified institutional placement, QIP, marks another important milestone, strengthening our balance sheet and providing the financial flexibility to accelerate growth across manufacturing, sourcing and high value-added segments.

risks_headwinds.claim: Transportation and inbound freight costs have risen due to global macroeconomic events such as Red Sea movements.
risks_headwinds.quote: That is because of our costing with respect to freight cost, due to the macroeconomic events what we are seeing globally, with the Red Sea movements and hikes in the prices, like fuel and every other cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Nigeria implemented a temporary export ban on shea nuts.
risks_headwinds.quote: So that is one country which has put a temporary ban. So that doesn't materially impact our sourcing strategy from there because our presence in that geography area is vast, which is substantial in Africa region.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects project timelines for the Burkina Faso project around Q3 and Q4 of financial year 2028.
management_commitments.quote: We are expecting our project timelines towards financial year '28, which should be around Q3, Q4 of that particular financial year.

management_commitments.claim: Proposed capex is planned over the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: Proposed capex over the next 2–3 years ^

management_commitments.claim: Solvent fractionation 3 and the refinery are targeted for commissioning around Q3 of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So on the solvent fractionation 3 and our refinery are being targeted for commissioning around FY 28, around Q3 of that financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to invest approximately INR 220 crores more in capex during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Until today, we have spent around INR 70 crores out of our total proposed capex plan, and we intend to spend approximately around INR 220 odd crores more in this financial year for our capex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
